purpose: Three illustrative photo backgrounds for code-native carousel template
prompts: Create one photorealistic candid editorial lifestyle photograph, portrait 4:5, for an Everlittle baby memory journal Instagram carousel. Full-bleed photograph only, NO text, NO logos, no borders. Warm natural everyday family home, muted earthy sage/cream/oak, subtle grain, realistic intimate details, never glossy stock photo. The upper 55% must be softly blurred relatively plain darker background with no prominent objects so large white text can be added later; main subject in lower 45%. No recognizable faces, no identifiable private information. Scene: parent-eye view at a worn oak kitchen table. In the lower foreground a small yellow banana and a toddler's small hand pointing at it beside a simple cream bowl, caregiver's hand nearby. Background softly blurred sage kitchen. The mood is amused tenderness: the first funny little word. Anatomically correct hand. One banana, no other food clutter.
